clue.text: Yellowish-brown saint placed at the back of church rooms

indicators.note: the colour and the saint are set after the church abbreviation, at its back

parts.note: amber is a yellowish-brown colour

explanation.surface: A description of a church decorated in amber, with a saint's statue at the back.
explanation.definitionFit: Chambers is a formal or old word for rooms, as in a judge's private office suite.

clue.text: Old king accommodating theologian and cook

indicators.note: the old king takes in, houses, the theologian's letters

parts.note: Old King Cole is the merry monarch of the nursery rhyme
DD, Doctor of Divinity, stands for a theologian

explanation.surface: An ancient monarch puts up a scholar of religion and a kitchen hand.
explanation.definitionFit: To coddle eggs is to cook them gently in water just below boiling.

clue.text: Stars entertaining thousand groups of soldiers

indicators.note: to entertain a guest is to hold them within, so the stars hold the thousand

parts.note: Aries is a constellation, a group of stars
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand

explanation.surface: Celebrities putting on a show for a crowd of a thousand troops.
explanation.definitionFit: Armies are large organised bodies of soldiers, a plural to match the plural groups.

clue.text: They cover hair and will get in the way of lovers

indicators.text: will get in the way of
indicators.note: the little word comes between, intrudes upon, the lovers

parts.note: beaux is the plural of beau, a boyfriend or admirer

explanation.surface: Headwear that obstructs courting couples, as if hats interfered with romance.
explanation.definitionFit: Bandeaux are narrow bands worn round the head to hold the hair in place.

clue.text: Cut of meat in a sort of bar

definitions.meaning: a ... of lamb is a joint of ribs from the animal
the toothed bar engaging a pinion gear in ... and pinion steering

explanation.surface: A butcher describing a joint served in a pub.
explanation.definitionFit: The same word names a rib joint and a straight toothed bar in machinery.

clue.text: Demanding activity for HMRC

definitions.meaning: arduous or wearing, as a strenuous job is
HMRC, His Majesty's Revenue and Customs, is the UK tax authority, whose work is levying duties

explanation.surface: A complaint that the revenue service's work is hard going.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both burdensome and, literally, levying duties, the revenue office's job.

clue.text: Chemicals containing arsenic dumped outside tunnel

indicators.note: the arsenic symbol is left around the tunnel, one letter on each side

parts.note: As is the chemical symbol for arsenic
a mine is an excavated tunnel

explanation.surface: Poisonous waste left beside a mine tunnel, a pollution story.
explanation.definitionFit: Amines are organic compounds derived from ammonia, a class of chemicals.

clue.text: Diminished politician's explanation for abstaining

definitions.meaning: weakened or reduced in strength or quality
an MP who is paired with an opponent agrees not to vote

explanation.surface: A weakened MP explaining why they did not vote.
explanation.walkthrough: In Parliament, two opposing MPs may be 'paired', both agreeing to miss a vote; split as I'M PAIRED the answer is that excuse.
explanation.definitionFit: Something impaired is damaged or reduced, so weakened in function.

clue.text: What star visitor is doing in gig — tunes newly arranged

indicators.note: the letters are set out in a fresh order, as music is rearranged

explanation.surface: A celebrity performer drops in on a concert and reworks the songs.
explanation.definitionFit: A guest star appearing on someone else's show is said to be guesting on it.

clue.text: A fish heading back around little island

indicators.note: the reversed pair goes round the word for little
the article and the fish are read in the backward direction

parts.note: a cod is a common sea fish
mini means small or little

explanation.surface: A fish swimming back home around a small island.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heading back' turns the article and fish together, so the A ends the answer; Dominica is not to be confused with the Dominican Republic.
explanation.definitionFit: Dominica is a Caribbean island nation in the Lesser Antilles.

clue.text: Spot politician in tall building

indicators.note: the politician goes inside the building's word

parts.note: a pile is a large imposing building
MP, Member of Parliament, is a politician

explanation.surface: Catching sight of an MP in a skyscraper.
explanation.definitionFit: A pimple is a small raised blemish on the skin, a spot.

clue.text: In reality, disorderly two-faced wife will be sent packing!

indicators.note: out of order, so the letters are jumbled
dismissed, so the wife's letter is removed from the pool

explanation.surface: A deceitful, unruly wife is thrown out of the house, in real life.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove W from TWOFACED and rearrange the remaining letters.
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin phrase means existing in fact, whether or not by right.

clue.text: Songs for which prominent violinist provides the sound

indicators.note: the violinist's title is spoken and gives the answer's pronunciation

parts.note: the leader of an orchestra is its principal first violinist

explanation.surface: Songs for which the star fiddler supplies the music.
explanation.definitionFit: Lieder are German art songs, as by Schubert, for voice and piano.

clue.text: Man at the head of order

definitions.text: Man at the head of order

parts.words: Man at the head of order
parts.note: Saint ... founded the monastic order named after him, so he heads it

explanation.surface: A man in charge of maintaining order, like a chairman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'order' reads as discipline, but here it is a religious order of monks.
explanation.definitionFit: Benedict of Nursia founded the Benedictines, the monastic order bearing his name.

clue.text: First item on menu? It could be horse!

definitions.meaning: the opening course of a meal, an appetiser
a horse that lines up to run in a race is one of its runners

explanation.surface: A joke about horse meat appearing as an appetiser.
explanation.definitionFit: The word covers both an opening course and any horse taking part in a race.

clue.text: Deer can't jump without tail sadly

indicators.note: in a sorry or poor state, so the letters are disordered

parts.note: taken as written, without the apostrophe

indicators.note: the last letter of jump is cut off

explanation.surface: A pitiful deer that is unable to leap because it has lost its tail.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without tail' cuts JUMP to JUM; 'sadly' then rearranges CANT and JUM.
explanation.definitionFit: The muntjac is a small Asian deer, now widespread in English woodland.

clue.text: Vessel with French wine passed around table finally

indicators.note: the wine goes round the last letter, encircling it

parts.note: vin is French for wine

indicators.note: take only the end letter of table

explanation.surface: A ship's crew passing wine round the dining table.
explanation.definitionFit: A vein is a blood vessel carrying blood back to the heart.

clue.text: Beat up rich man in island republic

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is read from the bottom upward

parts.note: to lam is to thrash or beat
Dives is the rich man in the parable of Lazarus

explanation.surface: A wealthy tourist assaulted at a tropical holiday destination.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' reverses LAM to MAL in this down clue. Dives is the Latin name traditionally given to the rich man of Luke 16.
explanation.definitionFit: The Maldives is an Indian Ocean nation of coral atolls and a republic.

clue.text: Unshaven king drowning in Irish drink

indicators.note: the king's letter is submerged inside the spirit

parts.note: Irish whiskey is spelt with an E
R, for rex, is the Latin abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A bearded monarch drowning his sorrows in Irish spirit.
explanation.definitionFit: Whiskery means bristly or bearded, as a face left unshaved becomes.

clue.text: Mathematical process in class

definitions.meaning: sharing a number into equal parts, the opposite of multiplying
a category or rank, as a football league's tiers

explanation.surface: A sum learnt in a school lesson.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both an arithmetic operation and a grouping or league tier.

clue.text: Bill and Henry completely gutted, feeling pain

parts.note: AC, account, is a bill

indicators.note: with every inner letter of the name removed, only its first and last remain

explanation.surface: Two men, Bill and Henry, utterly devastated and in pain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'completely gutted' sounds like an emotional state but strips HENRY down to HY.
explanation.definitionFit: Achy describes someone suffering dull aches, as after exercise.

clue.text: Country needs someone clever with a grasp of modern technology

indicators.note: holding something tightly, so the clever person's word encloses the technology

parts.note: a brain is an intelligent person
IT, information technology

explanation.surface: A claim that the nation needs tech-savvy brainpower to thrive.
explanation.definitionFit: Britain is the country made up of England, Scotland and Wales.

clue.text: Go with internal energy doubled, as one full of soup?

indicators.note: the letters are placed inside the word for go

parts.note: a turn is a go, as in a game

indicators.note: the energy symbol appears twice

parts.note: E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Advice on eating twice the soup to boost one's energy.
explanation.definitionFit: A tureen is a deep serving dish holding soup at the table.

clue.text: Notice opening time for Christmas shopping?

parts.note: an ad, advertisement, is a public notice
a vent is an opening or outlet

explanation.surface: A sign announcing the store's festive season hours.
explanation.definitionFit: Advent is the church season of preparation in the weeks before Christmas.

clue.text: Something with burning contents official examiner reported

indicators.note: spoken out, so the examiner's title gives the pronunciation

parts.note: a censor examines films or letters officially

explanation.surface: An inspector filing a report about something on fire.
explanation.definitionFit: A censer is a vessel in which incense burns, swung in church services.

clue.text: Is queen in parliament showing anxiety?

indicators.note: the pair of pieces sits inside the assembly's name

parts.note: a diet is a legislative assembly, as in Japan
taken as written

explanation.surface: A question whether the monarch's appearance in Parliament reveals nerves.
explanation.definitionFit: Disquiet is a feeling of unease or worry.

clue.text: One offering cryptic clues to sift

definitions.meaning: a puzzling question or enigma gives baffling hints
to pass soil or gravel through a coarse sieve

explanation.surface: A setter of puzzles told to sort through material.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both an enigmatic puzzle and a coarse sieve or sieving it.

clue.text: Theatrical place enjoyed by holidaymakers?

definitions.meaning: affected and exaggerated in manner, over the top
a holiday site with tents or chalets

explanation.surface: A stagey resort where tourists have fun.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both flamboyantly affected and a site for tents or holiday cabins.

clue.text: Eve, terribly embarrassed, turned away

indicators.note: badly, so the letters of the name are muddled

parts.note: red in the face from embarrassment

explanation.surface: Eve, mortified, looked away in shame.
explanation.definitionFit: To veer is to change direction suddenly, swerving off course.

clue.text: Sins executed with zeal — different from this one?

indicators.note: carried out, performed in a new form, so the letters are reworked

explanation.surface: Wrongdoing done with enthusiasm, unlike one particular deadly sin.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition points back at the clue: sloth is one sin that is never committed with zeal.
explanation.definitionFit: Idleness, sloth, is the opposite of zeal and is one of the seven deadly sins.

clue.text: Carol harbours a yen for making a statement

indicators.note: holds within, as a port shelters ships

parts.note: to carol is to sing joyfully
Y is the abbreviation for the Japanese yen

explanation.surface: A carol singer with a longing to say something.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying is the present participle of say, speaking or declaring.

clue.text: Miss goes quickly around, severe no end

parts.note: rotates rapidly, whirls

indicators.note: drop the final letter of the word for severe

parts.note: stern means strict or severe

explanation.surface: A young woman whirls about, her strictness gone.
explanation.definitionFit: Miss is the title of an unmarried woman, which a spinster is.
